resources.string: Control agents reach this phone over Tailscale, a free private network between your own devices. You don\'t need to create a network: signing in to Tailscale makes one for you. Sign in with the same account on this phone and on the computer where your control agent runs. Each step below shows when it\'s done.
Get the free Tailscale app from the Play Store.
Tap Install. Bridgit downloads the free Tailscale app from Tailscale\'s own site (about 100 MB) and installs it. Android may ask you to confirm once.
Tap Install in Android\'s box. Tailscale opens next so you can sign in.
Tailscale is installed. Sign in to it, then come back here.
Turn on \"Allow from this source\" for Bridgit, come back, and tap Install again.
Couldn\'t install Tailscale: %1$s. Tap Install to try again.
2. Sign in and turn it on
Open Tailscale and sign in with Google, Microsoft, Apple or GitHub. The first time, tap Connect and allow Android\'s VPN request. After that, Bridgit can turn it on for you.
On. This phone is %1$s on your network %2$s.
On. This phone\'s Tailscale address is %1$s.
Bridgit can do this with its ADB link: no VPN request, Tailscale comes back after a restart, and battery saving never stops it.
So Tailscale comes back after a restart: in VPN settings tap the gear next to Tailscale and turn on Always-on VPN. Leave Block connections without VPN off.

Tap Open, then tap the words “Allow background usage” (not the switch) and pick Unrestricted, so Android doesn\'t put Tailscale to sleep. On older phones: Battery → Unrestricted, or Battery optimisation → Don\'t optimise.
Tailscale didn\'t connect. Open it, check you\'re signed in, and tap Connect.
%1$d of %2$d settings worked. Always-on VPN starts with the next restart.

Install Tailscale on the computer where your control agent runs and sign in with the same account as this phone. The easiest way: give your control agent this prompt and let it do the work. It will send you a sign-in link to open.

Install Tailscale on the computer where your control agent runs and sign in with the same account as this phone (your network is %1$s). The easiest way: give your control agent this prompt and let it do the work. It will send you a sign-in link to open.

"Join my Tailscale network
──────────────

1. Install Tailscale on this computer:
 https://tailscale.com/download

2. Sign in with the same Tailscale account my phone uses.

Once signed in, this computer and my phone are on the same private network.

—
Sent from Bridgit · bridgit.cc"
Put your computer on my Tailscale network
Bridgit\'s relay reaches this phone without Tailscale. It does most of what Tailscale does, but replies are smaller, it\'s slower, and live features like video and screen sharing are off by default.
